name: us2-company-managed-discovery
description: Company-managed (classic) project discovery: style detected first, then the scheme-based per-style path. Both ports must produce a byte-identical binding, exit code, and Jira API call sequence (NFR-1). Discovery parity is asserted directly in tests/bash/sink/test_discovery_company.bats; this golden scenario is wired end-to-end through the config command in US1.
